notes.title: New Content & Quality of Life Patch
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to roll out a major update packed with new features and improvements that bring deeper immersion and polish to the experience:

🔊 [b]Voice Acting & Dialogue[/b]
Characters now come to life with fully integrated voice acting and dynamic dialogues, enhancing the narrative and player connection.

🎭 [b]Dynamic Set Pieces[/b]
Environments and story elements now load dynamically, making each scene feel more cinematic and immersive.

🖥️ [b]Complete UI Overhaul[/b]
We've rebuilt the entire UI from the ground up for a cleaner, more intuitive experience. It is easier to navigate and better to look at.

🛠️[b] Refined Mechanics[/b]
Core gameplay mechanics have been tweaked and balanced for smoother, more satisfying play.

🐞 [b]Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
We’ve squashed numerous bugs and made a ton of quality-of-life improvements. A full list of changes and fixes is available below.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Drag certificate prompt re appears after solving
[*]Speakers not hidden after set pieces load
[*]Soft lock in receptionist's level transition
[*]Sometimes inventory item can be doubled
[*]Artist's last dialogue overflows the screen
[/list]
[b]QOL Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Lobby level keypad visibility low
[*]Changed player's height to make it lower
[*]Sensitivity control now has a 0.1 factor rather than 0.5
[*]Calendar instructions are now at bottom of the calendar mesh for better visibility
[*]Changed clipboard mesh for better game feel
[*]Added different interact icons for better interaction separation
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes, UI Improvement and lighting changes
notes.notes: We have fixed some bugs that were reported in the game and made some UI improvements as well. Hope this improves your experience!
